collection.title: VW Golf Convertible 2011 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Golf Convertible 2011 - 2016 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
